comment: GRADUATED from adversarial: phone number with spaces between every digit, embedded in prose. Caught by the narrow digit-only stitch pass (digitStitch), which complements the broad whitespaceStitch — the broad pass would fuse the prose into the digits and break the phone regex's `\b\d{3}` boundary; the narrow pass treats letters as region blockers so the digit cluster is fused on its own, leaving the prose around it intact.
